title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
abstract: arXiv:2611.24059v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. translated_title: 重放而非重采样：长时程强化学习专家的离策略整合
translated_abstract: 前沿模型的后训练遵循一个通用方案：先用强化学习（RL）在每个领域分别训练一个专家模型，然后通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将这些专家整合为一个模型。这种整合方式代价高昂：学生模型需要在每个环境中重新采样，专家需要对每个采样的token进行打分，而且学生会继承最终专家模型的漂移。然而我们认为，专家的RL训练过程其实已经产生了整合所需的一切内容：带有采样概率和奖励的采样轨迹，以及专家从中学习的先后顺序。我们提出多专家回放策略蒸馏（MRPD），它按照专家自身的学习顺序将这些训练日志回放给学生模型。在每一步，策略梯度在这些已被打分的轨迹上重新计算，最终专家模型的分布则在被记录的前缀处进行蒸馏。遵循专家自身的轨迹减少了训练与推理之间的不匹配，并保持了……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出多专家回放策略蒸馏（MRPD），通过按专家的学习顺序回放其RL训练日志（而非代价高昂的重新采样）来整合多个长时程强化学习专家，从而大幅降低整合成本并缓解训练与推理的不匹配。
en_tdlr: MRPD consolidates multiple long-horizon RL experts by replaying their training logs in the order the experts learned, avoiding costly re-sampling and reducing train-inference mismatch.
